{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for any negative revenue values
print("Negative revenue values:")
print(sales_df[sales_df['revenue'] < 0]['revenue'])

# Check what 'converted' means: are all completed orders converted?
print("\nCompleted orders with converted=0:")
print(sales_df[(sales_df['status'] == 'completed') & (sales_df['converted'] == 0)])

# Check what 'converted' means: are all refunded orders converted?
print("\nRefunded orders with converted=1:")
print(sales_df[(sales_df['status'] == 'refunded') & (sales_df['converted'] == 1)])"}
